_comment: Canonical listing store. Status reflects VERIFICATION state. A listing may only carry status 'match' when its Active status has been read off a live MLS-sourced listing page (MLSListings/REMTRO, which republishes MetroList and CRMLS). Search-engine snippets are NOT a valid source of listing status.

dataQuality.source: MLSListings / REMTRO (www.mlslistings.com), which republishes the MetroList MLS feed for El Dorado County plus CRMLS/Bay East records. Cross-checked against Century 21's IDX feed (also MetroList-sourced). MetroList data stamp: 2026-11-17.
dataQuality.coverage: Full active inventory pulled for all three target cities: Shingle Springs 50, Rescue 28, Placerville 259 active records (homes, land and commercial). Every record with 4+ bd, 3+ ba, <= $1.5M and >= 2.5 acres was opened individually and its structured Pool field read.
dataQuality.note: The network block that defeated the 2026-07-26 run is gone. Zillow, Redfin and Realtor.com still bot-block this container, but MLSListings and Century 21 serve full listing pages, so status, acreage and pool are now read from the MLS feed rather than inferred.

listings.blurb: Best value on the list. Single-story ranch on five oak-studded acres in Gold Hill, with valley and mountain views. Public water, septic. The cheapest property in the three towns that clears every criterion — $314/sqft.
listings.notes: Single-story ranch, 5.00 acres, in-ground pool. 47 days on market.

listings.blurb: Gated mini-ranch on 5 acres with a separate ADU — single-story main house, vaulted ceilings, horse property. $140/mo HOA. On market 103 days, so there may be room to negotiate.
listings.notes: Gunite in-ground pool, ADU, horse property, 5.00 acres. 103 days on market.

listings.blurb: The only Rescue property that qualifies. End-of-road privacy on 5.86 acres, built-in pool, plus a ~750 sqft entertainment hub (game room, extra room and bath) over the detached 3-car garage. Listing opens with “Major price reduction” — 138 days on market. Well water, $72/mo HOA.
listings.notes: Custom two-storey, one bedroom downstairs. Horse property. Views toward Sacramento. Confirmed Active on both MLSListings and Century 21 feeds.

listings.blurb: The most land per dollar, and the only 5-bedroom match. Gated estate on 16.74 acres atop Bedford Canyon with panoramic views, built 2001, 3-car garage, permitted for short-term rental. Relisted at $225K below its Dec-2024 asking price.
listings.notes: Listed through CRMLS (Bay East) rather than MetroList, which is why most El Dorado County searches miss it. Verified Active on both MLSListings and Century 21; Century 21 record updated 2026-11-17.

listings.blurb: Newest on the list — 12 days. Estate at the end of a cul-de-sac in gated Greenstone Country. Gunite pool with private spa, horse property, $213/mo HOA. 3 acres, so it clears the minimum but not the 5-acre preference.
listings.notes: Gated community. 4 full + 1 half baths. Public water, septic.

listings.blurb: 40 acres and 5,351 sqft — the biggest house and the biggest parcel under budget. European-country estate built as the builder's own residence, sweeping Sierra foothill views. Well water, $400/mo HOA. 154 days on market.
listings.notes: Largest acreage and largest home of any qualifying property. Long days-on-market suggests negotiating room.

listings.blurb: At the top of the budget, exactly. Gated hilltop compound on 11+ acres above Placerville, 5,821 sqft, built for multi-generational living and car storage, panoramic Central Valley views. Well water, septic. Listed 17 days.
listings.notes: Priced at the $1.5M ceiling with no headroom. 4 full + 2 half baths.

listings.blurb: Cheapest pool property that gets close. Two caveats: the MLS counts 3 baths as 2 full plus a half, and the 2.66 acres is two parcels (1.39 + 1.3), not one. Horse property, in-ground pool, 148 days on market.
listings.notes: Included because it is otherwise a strong fit and the second parcel is flat and buildable. Decide whether a half bath counts toward the 3BA minimum.
